comment: Routing-table commands of the laneconductor skill that have NO command in the catalog (connector/src/commands.mjs, which becomes both the MCP prompts and plugins/laneconductor/commands/*.md). connector/test/plugin-coverage.test.mjs fails when a routing-table name is neither a catalog command (or an alias of one, below) nor listed here, and when a catalog command is neither a routing name, an alias target, nor listed under catalogOnly.

init-tracks-summary.reason: The connector regenerates tracks-summary.md on every write; `lc summary` remains for plain edits made outside the connector.

revert.reason: Needs judgement about which commit and which phase to undo; a thin command would hide that decision.

delete.reason: Destructive, no undo, and the skill runs it only when named; a one-keystroke command invites accidents. The safe alternative is /laneconductor:move N backlog.

catalogOnly.review-plan: A plugin command that dispatches the read-only plan-reviewer subagent; the skill's routing table has no row for it because it is not a skill procedure.
catalogOnly.help: New in track AM-10116: lists every command with an example phrase (a FITI-style help). The skill has no routing row for it: asking what LaneConductor can do is not a skill procedure.
